firmware.name: MicroPython ESP32_GENERIC-SPIRAM
firmware.offline_check: esptool 4.8.1: ESP32 image, bootloader checksum and validation hash valid

bench_verification.boot_banner: MicroPython v1.29.0 on 2026-08-24; Generic ESP32 module with SPIRAM with ESP32
bench_verification.psram_evidence: 2 MiB byte buffers allocated and SHA256-verified for 0x55 and 0xAA patterns in separate fresh-boot runs.
bench_verification.pre_flash_state: Whole-device ROM MD5 matched a 4 MiB all-0xFF image; reconstructed blank image saved with provenance.
limitations: Bulk stub flash reads returned truncated packets, at both 460800 and 115200 baud. Flash write at 115200 succeeded and its hash verified.
Initial 2 MiB slice-fill loop tests exceeded 45 seconds and were interrupted; their performance remains unexplained. The later bulk pattern/hash checks passed.
Two sequential 2 MiB allocations in one REPL execution raised MemoryError despite del/gc.collect. Separate fresh-boot runs passed. Do not assume repeated large allocations are safe.
These checks establish boot and basic external-memory use, not exhaustive physical PSRAM coverage or sustained audio performance.

required_adaptations: Bound DREQ waits with timeouts for disconnected or failed hardware.
Set low volume after every reset; do not use the upstream full-volume sine test unchanged.
Remove the unused native playback decorator for the ESP32 port and explicitly import micropython.const.
Add pause/resume in the buffered feed loop and reset cancellation state between tracks.
Check filesystem APIs and import compatibility on the selected MicroPython release.
Start audio data SPI at 8 MHz on breadboard jumpers; retain the driver's slower initialization and SCI rates.

display.color_order_reason: Full BGR pattern confirmed by Dave using SoftSPI at 250 kHz.

wiring.numbering: ESP32 GPIO numbers, not physical header positions

power.3V3: regulator output; do not join to Olimex 3V3

audio.jack_pin_identification: Use multimeter continuity to identify physical jack legs before wiring.
audio.storage: Use this module's microSD slot; card must have a completed backup and FAT32 filesystem.
audio.dreq_selection: GPIO4 replaces GPIO36 to avoid ambiguous board labels. Dave confirmed connection; DREQ/reset and SCI communication verified on September 19.

bench_verification.ground_connection: Dave clarified that the VS1053 GND wire is on WROVER GND, not GPIO13.
bench_verification.probe_execution: Ran from RAM through raw REPL; no automatic boot script installed.
limitations: Full song and album not tested
Completed solder rows not visually inspected; Dave could not provide close-ups

jack_verification.method: Dave used an inserted male-to-male TRS cable and multimeter continuity.
jack_verification.orientation: Jack viewed on its back, opening pointing south

display.controller_miso_connection: none; GPIO35 is only the unused SPI controller input

power.3V: display regulator output; do not join to Olimex 3V3

display.SDCS: display 3V output to deselect unused SD socket
display.header_status: Dave reports 11-pin header soldering completed; September 19, 2026.
display.wiring_status: Dave reports wiring completed and USB reconnected. Display draw commands completed; visual confirmation pending.

buttons_reserved.connection: Normally open switch between each input and VS1053 3V3 output; active high.
buttons_reserved.bias: Adafruit schematic R8/R16 provide 100k pulldowns; verify idle input readings on the physical board.
buttons_reserved.configuration: VS1053 pins_direction(0); read pins(); debounce in software; leave I2S disabled and GPIO0/1 untouched.
buttons_reserved.first_button_wiring: VS1053 3V3 to GPIO2 through tactile button straddling breadboard center trench. Three debounced presses/releases verified.
buttons_reserved.all_buttons_wiring: Dave reports all five buttons wired: play/pause GPIO2, next GPIO3, previous GPIO4, volume up GPIO5, volume down GPIO6, each switched to VS1053 3V3. Five-button verification pending.

remaining_bench_checks: Uninterrupted full-album playback with responsive controls and no crashes or persistent dropouts; this also checks album-length memory/playback stability. SD-related clicks and track-transition artifacts are accepted for Mark-5.

first_playback.end_state: Volume attenuated to 0xFEFE, decoder held in reset, SD unmounted, SPI deinitialized
first_playback.scope: Short excerpt only; no full-song, album or UI/control acceptance claim

full_track_playback.user_feedback: Faint regular background clicks at roughly 120 beats per minute (about twice per second), noticeable during fade-in and fade-out.

internal_tone_diagnostic.user_feedback: Dave reports no clicks during the repeated 15-second tone test.

ram_playback_diagnostic.interpretation: Clean preloaded excerpt and internal tone point toward SD activity or feed delays during streaming; root cause not yet distinguished. RAM test also includes pre-run garbage collection and was 3 dB louder than original music test. Full-song streaming fix still required.

sd_latency_comparison.scope: Silent full-file reads with decoder held in reset. Both match full source SHA256. These are measured read latencies, not proof of audio underrun.

baseline.spi: SPI(id=2, baudrate=1311475, polarity=0, phase=0, bits=8, firstbit=0, sck=18, mosi=23, miso=19)

candidate.spi: SPI(id=2, baudrate=4000000, polarity=0, phase=0, bits=8, firstbit=0, sck=18, mosi=23, miso=19)

streaming_candidate_excerpt.spi: SPI(id=2, baudrate=4000000, polarity=0, phase=0, bits=8, firstbit=0, sck=18, mosi=23, miso=19)
changes: 4 MHz shared SPI after slow initialization

tone_sd_interference_diagnostic.sequence: 10 seconds idle, 10 seconds of 2048-byte card reads every 500 ms, 10 seconds idle
tone_sd_interference_diagnostic.user_feedback: Clicks audible in middle phase, not beginning or end.
tone_sd_interference_diagnostic.interpretation: SD activity reproducibly couples into audible output even without MP3 feeding. Electrical interference is the working diagnosis; precise coupling path (power, ground, signal crosstalk) remains unverified. Faster/smaller reads did not fix it.

audio_noise_disposition.decision: Dave accepts faint SD-related clicks for this prototype and explicitly requests moving on to controls and display.

display_probe.visual_confirmation: Geometry confirmed in IMG_7633; normal BGR pattern later confirmed via 250 kHz SoftSPI. Hardware-SPI tests became blank after wiring work; root cause not established.
display_probe.execution: Driver, font, and probe loaded through raw REPL into RAM; no boot script installed. Explicit micropython/const imports added to driver load; namespace class used because this runtime cannot construct module instances. Audio held in reset; SPI released with image left visible.

first_button_probe.interpretation: Previously working decoder now fails communication after display/button wiring. No button state was verified. Physical cause unconfirmed; isolate latest two button jumpers before retry.
first_button_probe.end_state: Reset asserted; all audio/SD chip selects high; SPI deinitialized

button_disconnected_retest.user_action: Dave disconnected the two new button jumpers with power off and reconnected USB.
button_disconnected_retest.next: Inspect existing VS1053 power/reset/SPI wiring. Removing button connections did not restore communication; do not attribute failure to switch alone.

latest_retest.trigger: Dave requested retry after an unspecified adjustment.
latest_retest.interpretation: Reset/DREQ behavior now correct; SCI reads still zero. Check SPI wiring, starting with VS1053 MISO to ESP32 GPIO19.

connection_recovery.trigger: Dave reviewed complete pin map and requested retry; exact wiring correction not yet reported.

reconnected_test.interpretation: After reconnecting button, GPIO2 remained high for entire 35-second observation; no press/release edges. Suspect breadboard strips bypassing switch; inspect/reposition button across center trench. Reset/DREQ low observation was also high on this run, though SCI communication passed.

verified_test.wiring: Button now straddles breadboard center trench; diagonal contacts connect VS1053 3V3 and GPIO2.
verified_test.scope: Debounced physical input verified. Music play/pause behavior not yet implemented.

all_buttons_probe.scope: Five physical inputs verified; integrated playback controls not yet tested.

integrated_player.test_collection_note: Unscoped pytest entered vendored KiCad Python tests and failed collection; explicit project tests passed.
integrated_player.startup: Ready and silent until physical play/pause press; RAM only, no automatic boot installed.
integrated_player.next_previous_behavior: Wrap the single-track list and restart Higher during playback; preserve paused state when skipping while paused.
integrated_player.pause_behavior: Stop feeding without reset or discarding file bytes; already queued decoder audio drains briefly.
integrated_player.user_feedback: Audio and controls worked, but Dave clarified that nothing appeared on the display during the integrated test.
integrated_player.display_symptom: Backlight glowing, blank image per Dave.

display_recheck.visual_confirmation: Dave reports backlit but blank after standalone redraw and power-cycle followed by another redraw.
display_recheck.voltage_feedback: Dave replied yes to 3V and RST readings expected near 3.3 V; exact numbers were not provided.

softspi_isolation.method: Independent ST7789 reset/init and all-white fill of entire 240x320 controller RAM; no st7789py/font code used.

normal_driver_softspi.visual_result: Dave confirms full pattern visible with normal driver using SoftSPI.

integrated_player_softspi.user_feedback: Backlit blank display; delayed music onset followed by starting and stopping with all buttons released.
integrated_player_softspi.interpretation: False play/pause input events recorded. Decoder time lagged far behind bytes sent. Cause not established; standalone display success does not verify integration.
integrated_player_softspi.subsequent_stop: Device identity verified and GPIO32 asserted low; AUDIO_HELD_IN_RESET acknowledged.

integration_silent_isolation.display_visual_confirmation: Dave confirms SILENT TEST and white border visible.
integration_silent_isolation.interpretation: No false button edges during brief silent samples. Does not exclude a fault during streaming or intermittent wiring.

integration_update_isolation.phases: 10 seconds static screen, 10 seconds writing one glyph every loop, 10 seconds static screen
integration_update_isolation.finding: Continuous glyph updates reduced feed throughput to roughly 9.7 KB/s, below the 16 KB/s track bitrate. No phantom inputs reproduced. This stress test demonstrates a feed-budget problem but does not explain the earlier blank screen or false input events.
integration_update_isolation.display_visual_confirmation: Dave confirms MUTED UPDATE TEST and border visible.

integration_update_feed32.change: Increase pump budget from 8 to 32 packets per loop
integration_update_feed32.finding: Decoder time remained zero for entire 30-second muted test despite 730112 bytes sent by 29.773 s. No false button edges recorded. Not an accepted fix; reverted to 8 packets. Cause unestablished.
integration_update_feed32.end_state: Decoder reset, SD unmounted, SPI deinitialized
integration_update_feed32.next: Physical USB power cycle with all buttons released, then fresh-state checks.

original_playback_comparison.hardware_spi: Decoder remained at zero over 10 s
original_playback_comparison.software_spi_500khz: Decoder remained at zero over 10 s

data_path.interpretation: VS1053 GPIO_IDATA bit 11 does not follow commanded ESP32 GPIO26 low transitions. Inspect/reseat GPIO26 to XDCS connection with USB off. Exact physical defect and relation to blank display not established.

fresh_power_cycle_checks.end_state: Decoder held in reset; card unmounted; no persistent code installed

xdcs_connection_recovery.user_action: Dave confirmed completing the power-off GPIO26-to-XDCS jumper reseat/replacement step; exact action not separately specified.

xdcs_repaired_muted_integration.scope: Muted decoding and visible updating screen passed. Audible playback and physical controls still require integrated retest.
xdcs_repaired_muted_integration.end_state: Decoder reset, SD unmounted, SPI deinitialized

integrated_player_xdcs_repaired.user_feedback: Yes, music, screen, and all five buttons work
integrated_player_xdcs_repaired.scope: Interactive single-track test. Includes pauses and restarts; not a two-minute continuous playback or full-album acceptance test.
integrated_player_xdcs_repaired.audio_noise: Previously accepted faint SD-related clicks remain deferred.

video_demo.scope: Five-minute session with about 55 seconds decoded and a long user pause; not continuous five-minute playback. Video capture itself not verified.
video_demo.end_state: Decoder muted and held in reset, SD unmounted, SPI deinitialized

session_review.assessment: Working single-track wired prototype; full-album acceptance outstanding.
accepted_limits: USB bench power and Micro-USB connector

album_support.behavior: Disc/track ordering, automatic EOF advance, stop after last track, next/previous wrap and preserve pause, title/index/duration display. Bench runner exits after album or time limit; reload for another session.

full_album_run.state: Interactive album test accepted by Dave. Manual skips and pause/resume are logged; track 5 subsequently completed with matching SHA256 and automatically advanced to track 6. Uninterrupted full-album acceptance remains outstanding.
full_album_run.audible_user_confirmation: Dave: "it works great." Reports an audio artifact at track transitions and explicitly accepts it for Mark-5.

track_transition_artifact_disposition.observation: Dave hears an audio artifact at track transitions.
track_transition_artifact_disposition.decision: Accepted by Dave for Mark-5; nonblocking and deferred for future versions.
track_transition_artifact_disposition.root_cause: Unconfirmed; recorded separately from the previously isolated SD-related clicks.

physical_prototyping_lessons.source: Dave, after successful interactive album test
physical_prototyping_lessons.breadboard: The available breadboard is insufficient for the development board width, forcing a clunky female-to-male jumper arrangement. Check board width and accessible header rows when selecting the next prototyping setup.
physical_prototyping_lessons.interfaces: Dave wishes he had bought button and other interface breakout boards rather than using bare pushbuttons on the breadboard. Plan suitable interface modules before the next build.
physical_prototyping_lessons.disposition: Neither is a Mark-5 showstopper. Retain both lessons for future versions; no purchase requested.

optional_followup: Persistent startup and recovery if adopted; current bench player requires loading from the Mac after power cycling.

cold_start_recheck.purpose: Dave asked to re-run the last test to capture video; used as a cold-start re-verification of the Mark-5 assembly.
cold_start_recheck.result: PLAYER_READY reached; Dave pressed Play; reached Paused on track 1 with decode_seconds 6 and sent_bytes 103072.
cold_start_recheck.stopped_by: Dave, via SIGINT to the host runner after roughly two minutes.
cold_start_recheck.acceptance_note: Too short to bear on the uninterrupted full-album check, which remains outstanding.
cold_start_recheck.clean_shutdown_note: The host closes the serial port immediately after sending the interrupt, so PLAYER_STOPPED was not captured. A subsequent port open for verification caused rst:0x1 POWERON_RESET, so cleanup cannot be distinguished from the reboot.
cold_start_recheck.verified_end_state: MicroPython 1.29.0 booted fresh, REPL responsive, nothing feeding the decoder, SD not mounted by the ESP32. Card was mounted read-only throughout, so an abrupt stop cannot corrupt it.
